summary: R1-R5 are all delivered and every acceptance criterion has implementing work I can point at, except the live-endpoint ones (V06, V11-V14, V18) which are the test phase's and the operator's by design, not owed by a phase. No done-record admits a leftover and no phase depends on something nothing produced. What is outstanding is four gaps the merged work exposed inside the two gate scripts this slice wrote, each named by a phase review as an advisory Minor and each a few lines: tests/publish.sh claims 'a published version is immutable' in its own header but passes an already-published tarball that has been silently rewritten (demonstrated by the P2 reviewer) - which is exactly the property D17's dependencies: pins and a consumer's Chart.lock rest on, and the reason this slice exists; tools/package-chart.sh is the one new executable nothing runs, with publish.sh re-implementing it instead; the ceph PVC helpers are rendered only on their legacy inline-PV branch, never the TF-owned one the B.1 migrations will use; and a hand-run `helm dependency update tests/consumer` writes two unignored files. Appended as P4 (Target ../Charts). Everything else advisory or out of scope is carded; no mechanical residue to fix (the diff is whitespace-clean, all four scripts parse, build-index.sh is dash-clean).
cards: HelmCharts: collect_version_dependencies.py runs `helm get values` for every discovered release with no namespace-exists guard - the guard resolve_helm_args.get_helm_args:95-97 does have - so a release that never installed (the pre-image window this slice opens) aborts version-poller runs repo-wide, killing drift detection for all ~45 releases rather than skipping one. Hardening it is a HelmCharts change outside this slice.

Architecture model: the new charts/charts chart, the charts-prd namespace and the charts.home ApplicationService are absent from docs/architecture/helm-charts.yaml - architecture.yaml is deliberately not written per HelmCharts' standing instruction, so the update-architecture agent owes a run once the release is deployed.
Charts is a new repo carrying only the .kubecoder/project.yaml this slice landed: no CLAUDE.md, no spec repo, no dev-pipeline onboarding. Worth /dev:onboard before it takes slices of its own.
